card.name: Old historical prose, mid-sentence words
card.fires_on: Ordinary connecting or descriptive words in the middle of sentences in 18th and 19th century historical or literary prose, such as 'is' after 'there' or 'activity' after 'Great'. It appears in old letters, diaries and history books, not in drug labels.

modes.label: Linking words in argument
modes.description: Small words like 'is', 'there', 'that' or 'to' inside a reasoned historical claim.
modes.example: because there<< is>> no kind of proof that the ancients

modes.label: Descriptive words in old narrative
modes.description: Adjectives or nouns such as 'activity', 'nice' or 'striking' in period history or diary text.
modes.example: Great<< activity>> in the Navy De partment Rebel battery

card.plain: It lights up on everyday words inside old-fashioned historical writing, such as letters, diaries and history books.
